title: The best Black Friday deals Ars could find
gist: A promotional Black Friday 2026 deal roundup from Ars Technica (affiliate-linked) listing discounts on laptops, Apple devices, TVs, headphones, phones and smart-home gear; the only investor signal is the depth of discounting by category, with large-screen TVs showing the steepest markdowns.

insights.claim: In Ars Technica's Black Friday 2026 roundup, large-screen TVs carry the deepest markdowns: the LG C6 OLED is listed at $1,400 ($1,300 off), the Hisense U7SG at $798 ($700 off), the TCL QM7L at $848 ($652 off) and Samsung The Frame (2025) at $898 ($600 off).
insights.speaker: Lee Hutchinson
insights.so_what: Near-50% holiday cuts on premium TVs signal aggressive price competition and margin pressure in the TV panel/set market.
insights.locator: Best TV and home audio deals

insights.claim: Roku is discounting its own Roku Pro Series OLED TV to $800 ($400 off) for Black Friday 2026, alongside its Streaming Stick Plus at $34.
insights.speaker: Lee Hutchinson
insights.so_what: Roku pushing branded OLED hardware at steep discounts reflects its strategy of subsidizing hardware to grow its platform footprint.
insights.locator: Best TV and home audio deals

insights.claim: Black Friday 2026 Apple discounts are moderate: MacBook Air at $999 ($300 off), the lower-priced MacBook Neo at $649 ($50 off), Mac Mini (M6) at $779 ($120 off) and AirPods Pro 3 at $149 ($100 off).
insights.speaker: Lee Hutchinson
insights.so_what: Apple's newest low-cost MacBook Neo sees only a token $50 cut, suggesting Apple is protecting pricing on its entry-level Mac.

insights.claim: Microsoft's Surface Laptop is listed at $900 for Black Friday 2026, a $470 discount and the largest cut among the computer deals listed by Ars Technica.
insights.speaker: Lee Hutchinson
insights.so_what: A deep Surface discount versus small cuts on rival Windows laptops may indicate weaker Surface sell-through.

insights.claim: Flagship Android phones are discounted around 15-20% for Black Friday 2026: Google Pixel 11 at $699 ($200 off), Pixel 11 Pro Fold at $1,649 ($250 off) and Samsung Galaxy S26 at $980 ($220 off).
insights.speaker: Lee Hutchinson
insights.so_what: Holiday flagship discounting is a read on Android premium-phone demand and promotional intensity.

insights.claim: Wearables are heavily promoted for Black Friday 2026, including the Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 at $199 ($101 off) and Google Pixel Watch 5 at $285 ($115 off).
insights.speaker: Lee Hutchinson
insights.so_what: Roughly one-third-off smartwatch pricing points to competitive pressure in the wearables category.

insights.claim: Ars Technica's Black Friday deals list is affiliate-monetized, and the publication points readers to sister outlet Wired for a longer deals list, showing Condé Nast titles leaning on holiday commerce content.
insights.speaker: Lee Hutchinson
insights.so_what: Holiday affiliate content is a seasonal revenue lever for digital publishers; treat such lists as promotional, not editorial signal.
